admissions.name: crm_account_fields

admissions.purpose_independence_test: CRM account attributes remain source facts independent of reconciliation policy.

admissions.name: registry_entity_fields

admissions.purpose_independence_test: Registry row attributes remain jurisdictional facts independent of identity policy.

admissions.name: contract_document
admissions.reason: Contract document identity from sources/contracts/*.md (C1 mechanical).
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Contract document identity is fixed by authoritative contract files.

admissions.name: contract_counterparty_name
admissions.reason: Counterparty name parsed from contract headers (C1 mechanical).
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Counterparty name on a contract is stated contract text, not a diligence judgment.

admissions.name: contract_effective_date
admissions.reason: Effective date parsed from contract sources (C1 mechanical).
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Effective date is stated contract text independent of active-contract policy.

admissions.name: contract_term_text

admissions.purpose_independence_test: Term language is verbatim contract text independent of obligation classification.

admissions.name: contract_expiry_date

admissions.purpose_independence_test: Explicit expiry dates are contract facts independent of diligence scope.

admissions.name: contract_document_kind
admissions.reason: Document kind from filename prefix and heading (C1 mechanical).
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Document kind follows filename and heading, not purpose-specific thresholds.

admissions.name: contract_coc_consent_required

admissions.name: contract_assignment_notice_required

admissions.purpose_independence_test: Whether assignment requires notice is determined from assignment clause language alone.

admissions.name: contract_exclusivity_present

admissions.purpose_independence_test: Whether exclusivity language appears in the contract is a textual fact.

admissions.name: contract_auto_renewal_present
admissions.reason: C3-resolved auto-renewal presence grounded in term language.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Whether auto-renewal language appears is a textual fact about term mechanics.

admissions.name: contract_rolling_term_present
admissions.reason: C3-resolved rolling-term presence grounded in term language.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Whether rolling-term language appears is a textual fact about term mechanics.

admissions.purpose_independence_test: Exact string equality between recorded names is mechanically determinable.

admissions.name: legal_name_form_variant
admissions.reason: Mechanically determinable legal-form suffix variants (C1).
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Legal-form suffix variants are mechanically determinable from recorded names.

admissions.name: source_asserted_same_entity
admissions.reason: C3 ACCEPT only when authoritative sources explicitly assert sameness.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Explicit same-entity statements in authoritative sources are world facts when grounded.

admissions.name: source_asserted_invoice_contract
admissions.reason: C3 ACCEPT only when authoritative sources explicitly link invoice to contract.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Explicit invoice-to-contract linkage in authoritative sources is a world fact when grounded.

admissions.name: invoice_is_open
admissions.reason: C4 derivation from invoice_fields.status without purpose policy.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Open invoice status follows billing source status without purpose policy.

admissions.name: contract_recorded_expired
admissions.reason: C4 derivation from contract_expiry_date and expired/not-renewed source language.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Expired status follows explicit expiry dates or expired/not-renewed source language.

admissions.name: contract_obligation_kind
admissions.reason: C4 projection of ACCEPT clause-presence relations to obligation kind labels.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Obligation kind labels trace to resolved clause-presence facts, not Purpose C dependency policy.

admissions.name: counterparty_identity_epistemic
admissions.reason: Purpose B epistemic reconciliation labels; meaning depends on identity policy.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Epistemic SAME_ENTITY/DISTINCT/UNRESOLVED labels depend on Purpose B reconciliation policy.

admissions.name: invoice_contract_association
admissions.reason: Purpose A association judgment with asserted/unresolved disposition.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Asserted versus unresolved invoice-contract linkage depends on Purpose A association threshold.

admissions.name: contract_acquisition_relevant
admissions.reason: Purpose A policy over world clause facts for acquisition relevance.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Acquisition relevance applies Purpose A clause-type policy to world clause facts.

admissions.name: contract_active_for_diligence
admissions.reason: Purpose A/C active-contract policy excluding expired SOWs.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Active-contract classification applies diligence policy to world expiry facts.

admissions.name: commercial_dependency_status
admissions.reason: Purpose C dependency classification requiring policy conjunction tests.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Dependent versus unresolved classification applies Purpose C conjunction policy.

admissions.name: purpose_a_exposure_invoice
admissions.reason: Purpose A output projection; not promoted to World IR.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Exposure report row selection is a Purpose A output artifact.

admissions.name: purpose_b_reconciliation_link
admissions.reason: Purpose B output projection; not promoted to World IR.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Reconciliation link rows are a Purpose B output projection.

admissions.name: purpose_c_dependency_entry
admissions.reason: Purpose C output projection; not promoted to World IR.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Dependency table rows are a Purpose C output projection.

limitations: Purpose IR relations and their dispositions are recorded in 06_admission.json but not persisted in 06_world/world.sqlite.
REJECT dispositions on clause-presence relations do not emit present=false tuples (kernel: no closed-world negation).
UNRESOLVED exclusivity dispositions on four contracts remain without world tuples.
contract_recorded_expired marks only positively expired contracts; non-expired contracts lack expired=false tuples.
Prior pass P2 omitted DERIVED relations; P6 registers invoice_is_open, contract_recorded_expired, and contract_obligation_kind.
